segments.text: Let me get a pen. Okay. Say the number again?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Thank you, Frank. You're doing the right thing.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Well, I don't want any trouble. Go ahead.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hello?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Good morning, I'm calling from Medicare about your coverage, am I speaking with Joan?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'll be quick, I know you're busy. Can you confirm you're still on Elm Avenue?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, still here. Forty years.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: This is just a routine courtesy call, nothing to worry about.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Alright.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: It's a beautiful day out there, isn't it?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: It is. I was going to sit on the porch.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Our records show your Medicare card was never updated to the new chip version.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Go on.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is your husband home, or is it just you?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Wait, who did you say you were with?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There is no number to call back, this department is outbound only. Please stay on the line, don't hang up.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Go on.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Just verify the last four of your Social Security number and I can get this processed.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: My son usually helps me with things like this.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Don't hang up. If you hang up now the case escalates and I can't stop it.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Well, I don't want any trouble. Go ahead.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a small processing fee of two thousand dollars. The quickest way is to pick up a gift card at the gas station and read me the numbers off the back.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hmm. Why would you need that over the phone?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hurry, please. This has to be done immediately or the whole thing falls through.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Alright, hold on, let me get a pen.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, which store is closest to you? Good. Take the phone with you in the car, we need to go right now.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Go on.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: When you get to the register, ask for the gift cards in the amounts I told you. Don't tell them what they're for.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hold on, the dog is barking. Okay, go ahead.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Good. I'll call you back in twenty minutes to get the numbers. Don't talk to anyone.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Okay.
